anlamlar.en: to go to an airport or station to say goodbye to someone
ornekler: We went to the airport to see her off.
His family came to see him off.

anlamlar.en: to understand that someone is trying to deceive you
ornekler: I saw through his lies immediately.
She saw through their plan.

anlamlar.en: to continue doing something until it is finished
ornekler: She was determined to see the project through.
We'll see this through together.

anlamlar.en: to deal with something or make sure it is done
ornekler: Don't worry, I'll see to the tickets.
The car needs seeing to.

anlamlar.en: to sell all of something so that none is left
ornekler: The concert sold out in two hours.
Sorry, we've sold out of bread.

anlamlar.en: to return something, especially because it is damaged or not right
ornekler: I sent the shoes back because they were too small.
She sent back her soup because it was cold.

anlamlar.en: to send a letter, document or parcel by post
ornekler: Have you sent off your application?
I sent off the form yesterday.

anlamlar.en: to order a sports player to leave the field because they have broken the rules
ornekler: He was sent off for a bad foul.
Two players were sent off in the second half.

anlamlar.en: to send something to a lot of people
ornekler: We sent out 200 invitations.
The company sent out a warning to customers.

anlamlar.en: to start a journey
ornekler: We set off early in the morning.
What time are you setting off?

anlamlar.en: to cause something to start, especially an alarm or explosion
ornekler: The smoke set off the fire alarm.
Someone set off a bomb.

anlamlar.en: to cause a series of events to start
ornekler: His remarks set off a huge argument.
The news set off a fall in prices.

anlamlar.en: to start a journey
ornekler: They set out for the mountains at dawn.
We set out on foot.

anlamlar.en: to start doing something with a particular aim
ornekler: She set out to become a doctor.
He set out to prove them wrong.

anlamlar.en: to explain ideas or facts in a clear and organized way
ornekler: The report sets out the main problems.
The rules are set out in the guide.

anlamlar.en: to start living in a place where you intend to stay, often with a partner
ornekler: He wants to settle down and have a family.
They settled down in a small town.

anlamlar.en: to become calm and quiet
ornekler: Settle down, children!
It took the baby a long time to settle down.

anlamlar.en: to start to feel happy in a new home or job
ornekler: Have you settled in at your new school?
It took a few weeks to settle in.

anlamlar.en: to go with someone to a place they have not visited before and show them the interesting parts
ornekler: Let me show you around the office.
She showed us around the town.

anlamlar.en: to try to make people admire you, in a way that is annoying
ornekler: He's always showing off in front of girls.
Stop showing off!

anlamlar.en: to show something to a lot of people because you are proud of it
ornekler: She showed off her new ring.
He wanted to show off his new car.

anlamlar.en: to arrive somewhere, especially when people are expecting you
ornekler: He didn't show up for the meeting.
She showed up an hour late.

anlamlar.en: to be easy to see
ornekler: The marks show up clearly in the photo.
The disease doesn't show up on X-rays.

anlamlar.en: to embarrass someone by behaving badly in front of others
ornekler: You showed me up in front of my friends!
He showed himself up at the party.

anlamlar.en: to stop a business, machine or system operating
ornekler: The factory shut down in 2010.
Shut down your computer before you leave.

anlamlar.en: to stop talking (impolite)
ornekler: Shut up and listen!
I wish he would shut up.

anlamlar.en: to close a building or room
ornekler: They shut up the shop and went home.
The house was shut up for the winter.

anlamlar.en: to write your name or enter your details when you arrive somewhere or start using a system
ornekler: All visitors must sign in at reception.
Sign in with your email and password.

anlamlar.en: to agree to take part in an activity or become a member of something
ornekler: I've signed up for a Spanish course.
Sign up for our newsletter.

anlamlar.en: to relax and not do anything
ornekler: Just sit back and enjoy the show.
You can't just sit back and wait for things to change.

anlamlar.en: to move your body so that you are sitting
ornekler: Please sit down.
She sat down next to me.

anlamlar.en: to move from lying to sitting, or to sit with your back straight
ornekler: He sat up in bed.
Sit up straight!

anlamlar.en: to stay awake until late at night
ornekler: We sat up talking until two o'clock.
She sat up all night with the baby.

anlamlar.en: to sleep until later in the morning than usual
ornekler: I usually sleep in on Sundays.
Sorry I'm late – I slept in.

anlamlar.en: to sleep at someone else's house for a night
ornekler: Can I sleep over at Emma's house?
My friends slept over after the party.

anlamlar.en: to become slower, or to make something slower
ornekler: Slow down, you're driving too fast!
The economy is slowing down.

anlamlar.en: to deal with a problem or difficult situation
ornekler: Can you sort out this problem for me?
They finally sorted out their differences.

anlamlar.en: to put things in order or separate them
ornekler: I need to sort out my clothes.
Sort out the papers you want to keep.

anlamlar.en: to speak more loudly
ornekler: Could you speak up, please? I can't hear you.
Speak up, the people at the back can't hear!

anlamlar.en: to say what you think clearly, especially to support someone
ornekler: It's time to speak up for our rights.
Nobody spoke up for him.

anlamlar.en: to end a romantic relationship
ornekler: She split up with her boyfriend last month.
His parents split up when he was five.

anlamlar.en: to divide into smaller groups or parts
ornekler: Let's split up into three groups.
The class was split up for the project.

anlamlar.en: to move a short distance away from something
ornekler: Stand back from the edge!
The police told everyone to stand back.

anlamlar.en: to continue to support someone when they are in a difficult situation
ornekler: Her husband stood by her through the illness.
I'll stand by you whatever happens.

anlamlar.en: to be ready to do something if necessary
ornekler: Ambulances are standing by.
Please stand by for further instructions.

anlamlar.en: to continue to believe in something you said or decided
ornekler: I stand by what I said.
The company stands by its decision.

anlamlar.en: to allow something bad to happen without doing anything
ornekler: We can't just stand by and watch.
How could you stand by and do nothing?

anlamlar.en: to be a short form of a word or name
ornekler: BBC stands for British Broadcasting Corporation.
What does "UN" stand for?

anlamlar.en: to support or represent a particular idea or principle
ornekler: I don't like what that party stands for.
The flag stands for freedom.

anlamlar.en: to accept a situation or behavior (usually negative)
ornekler: I won't stand for this kind of behavior.
She wouldn't stand for any nonsense.

anlamlar.en: to be very easy to see or notice
ornekler: Her red dress really stood out.
One student stood out from the rest.

anlamlar.en: to rise to a standing position
ornekler: Everyone stood up when the teacher came in.
Stand up straight!

anlamlar.en: to not meet someone you have arranged to meet
ornekler: He stood me up last night.
I was stood up on our first date.

anlamlar.en: to support or defend a person, idea or principle
ornekler: You must stand up for your rights.
She always stands up for her friends.

anlamlar.en: to begin by doing something
ornekler: Let's start off with some easy questions.
He started off as a waiter and became the manager.

anlamlar.en: to begin something again
ornekler: I made a mistake, so I had to start over.
After the divorce she moved abroad to start over.

anlamlar.en: to stay somewhere after other people have left
ornekler: I stayed behind to help the teacher.
Can you stay behind after the meeting?

anlamlar.en: to stay at home rather than go out
ornekler: I'm tired, I'll stay in tonight.
We stayed in and watched a film.

anlamlar.en: to go to bed later than usual
ornekler: We stayed up late watching films.
Don't stay up too late!

anlamlar.en: to leave an important job or position
ornekler: The president stepped down after ten years.
He decided to step down as manager.

anlamlar.en: to become involved in a difficult situation in order to help
ornekler: The teacher had to step in to stop the fight.
The government stepped in to save the bank.

anlamlar.en: to come out beyond a surface or edge
ornekler: A pen was sticking out of his pocket.
Don't stick your tongue out!

anlamlar.en: to be very easy to see or notice
ornekler: His bright yellow jacket really stuck out.
She stuck out because she was so tall.

anlamlar.en: to continue doing or using something and not change it
ornekler: We must stick to the plan.
Stick to the facts, please.

anlamlar.en: to defend or support someone, especially when others are criticizing them
ornekler: My brother always sticks up for me.
You should stick up for yourself.

anlamlar.en: to give a short description of the most important facts or ideas
ornekler: To sum up, the plan has three main advantages.
Can you sum up the story in one sentence?

anlamlar.en: to turn off a light or machine
ornekler: Switch off the lights when you leave.
Don't forget to switch off your phone.

anlamlar.en: to stop giving your attention to something
ornekler: I just switch off when he starts talking about football.
I need a holiday where I can switch off.

anlamlar.en: to turn on a light or machine
ornekler: Switch on the TV, the news is starting.
Can you switch the heating on?
